Defendants.

PLAINTIFF’S MOTION TO VACATE
THE SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 HEARING AND TO DECIDE
THE MOTION TO DISMISS ON THE PAPERS

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine moves the Court to vacate the hearing noticed for
September 30, 2026 (ECF No. 38) on the Motion to Dismiss of Defendant National Center for
Missing & Exploited Children (“NCMEC”) (ECF No. 10), and to decide the Motion on the papers
pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78 and Local Civil Rule 7(J). In support, Plaintiff states
as follows.

I, The Motion to Dismiss is before the Court on NCMEC’s motion and memorandum
(ECF Nos. 10, 11) and Plaintiff’s oppositions (ECF Nos. 20, 30). The written submissions present
the parties’ positions in full.

2. Plaintiff, the party opposing the Motion, does not require oral argument and has
filed a Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument contemporaneously with this Motion. Defendant Meta

Platforms, Inc. has likewise waived oral argument on its own Motion to Dismiss (ECF No. 23).

3 Plaintiff appears pro se and resides in Florida. Attendance at the September 30
hearing would require interstate travel and its attendant expense to argue a motion that the written
record already presents. Decision on the papers imposes no burden on any party.

4. On August 20, 2026, Plaintiff moved to continue the hearing on the Motion to
Dismiss pending resolution of his Rule 15(d) motion (ECF No. 29). If the Court vacates the
September 30 hearing and decides the Motion on the papers, ECF No. 29 is moot. The sequence in
which the Court decides the pending Rule 15(d) motion (ECF No. 26) and the Motion to Dismiss
remains with the Court.

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court vacate the September 30, 2026
hearing and decide the Motion to Dismiss (ECF No. 10) on the papers. A proposed order

accompanies this Motion.

Date: August 31, 2026 Respectfully submitted,

“YD

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se

1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307

(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE

I certify that on August 31, 2026, I submitted the foregoing Motion to Vacate the
September 30, 2026 Hearing and to Decide the Motion to Dismiss on the Papers to the Clerk of
Court through the Court’s Electronic Document Submission System for docketing on CM/ECF.

Upon docketing, counsel for all parties will receive notice through the Court’s CM/ECF system.

YD

Marvelle J. Ballentine
